core_obligations: Write j_*F_K as the filtered colimit of finite-type submodules

difficulty_reason: Prove valuative existence for Cohstack_{X/B} with X -> B proper of finite presentation: extend a coherent F_K on X_K over the valuation ring R; the generic-fibre embedding j is affine so j_*F_K is quasi-coherent, written as the filtered colimit of its finite-type submodules F_i (limits lemma); j_*F_K is a sheaf of K-vector spaces hence flat over R, and each submodule F_i is flat since flatness over a valuation ring equals torsion-freeness and that passes to submodules; finally j^*F_i -> F_K is injective for all i (j^*j_*F_K = F_K, a routine adjunction detail the author flags as omitted, and j^* exact) and surjective for large i because j^* commutes with colimits and F_K is finitely presented - its finitely many generators over an affine etale cover appear in some F_i.
